title: One voice at a time
alt: One child speaks with an open-hand gesture while two children listen.
scene: Three diverse children sit in a small circle. One speaks with a gentle open-hand gesture while the other two listen; all equally included. No adult.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Wide lesson composition with generous clean margins. Three diverse children sit in a small circle. One speaks with a gentle open-hand gesture while the other two listen; all equally included. No adult. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
